mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_debug_run ( run_id, trace_id, user_id, conversation_id, raw_user_message, intent, route_type, workflow, target_agent, agent_name, model, status, latency_ms, response_id, total_tokens, route_request_json, routing_decision_json, usage_json, output_json, error_message ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{traceId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{rawUserMessage}, #{intent}, #{routeType}, #{workflow}, #{targetAgent}, #{agentName}, #{model}, #{status}, #{latencyMs}, #{responseId}, #{totalTokens}, #{routeRequestJson}, #{routingDecisionJson}, #{usageJson}, #{outputJson}, #{errorMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trace_id = VALUES(trace_id), user_id = VALUES(user_id), conversation_id = VALUES(conversation_id), raw_user_message = VALUES(raw_user_message), intent = VALUES(intent), route_type = VALUES(route_type), workflow = VALUES(workflow), target_agent = VALUES(target_agent), agent_name = VALUES(agent_name), model = VALUES(model), status = VALUES(status), latency_ms = VALUES(latency_ms), response_id = VALUES(response_id), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), route_request_json = VALUES(route_request_json), routing_decision_json = VALUES(routing_decision_json), usage_json = VALUES(usage_json), output_json = VALUES(output_json), error_message = VALUES(error_message), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT run_id AS runId, trace_id AS traceId, user_id AS userId, conversation_id AS conversationId, raw_user_message AS rawUserMessage, intent, route_type AS routeType, workflow, target_agent AS targetAgent, agent_name AS agentName, model, status, latency_ms AS latencyMs, total_tokens AS totalTokens, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM agent_debug_run
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT run_id AS runId, trace_id AS traceId, user_id AS userId, conversation_id AS conversationId, raw_user_message AS rawUserMessage, intent, route_type AS routeType, workflow, target_agent AS targetAgent, agent_name AS agentName, model, status, latency_ms AS latencyMs, response_id AS responseId, total_tokens AS totalTokens, route_request_json AS routeRequestJson, routing_decision_json AS routingDecisionJson, usage_json AS usageJson, output_json AS outputJson, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM agent_debug_run WHERE run_id = #{runId}

SELECT id, run_id AS runId, step_order AS stepOrder, step_type AS stepType, agent_name AS agentName, input_json AS inputJson, output_json AS outputJson, usage_json AS usageJson, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt FROM agent_debug_step WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, run_id AS runId, prompt_key AS promptKey, prompt_version AS promptVersion, prompt_hash AS promptHash, agent_name AS agentName, model, system_prompt AS systemPrompt, developer_prompt AS developerPrompt, user_prompt AS userPrompt, variables_json AS variablesJson, created_at AS createdAt FROM agent_prompt_snapshot WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, run_id AS runId, prompt_key AS promptKey, prompt_version AS promptVersion, prompt_hash AS promptHash, agent_name AS agentName, model, LEFT(system_prompt, 240) AS systemPromptSummary, LEFT(developer_prompt, 240) AS developerPromptSummary, LEFT(user_prompt, 240) AS userPromptSummary, created_at AS createdAt FROM agent_prompt_snapshot
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
